## What changed

Describe the product-risk decision, detector, checker, benchmark, documentation, or release behavior changed by this pull request.

## Evidence contract

- [ ] New or changed detectors include a minimal positive and closest negative/adversarial twin.
- [ ] New checker behavior includes a baseline/mutant pair or explains why no deterministic checker claim is being added.
- [ ] Control IDs and pack routing reuse the catalog source of truth.
- [ ] No target code is executed and no secret value, private source, or absolute local path enters an artifact or test fixture.
- [ ] Public claims remain within the documented benchmark and support boundaries.

## Verification

List the exact tests, benchmark suites, validators, and platforms used.

## Compatibility and schema impact

State whether this changes tool behavior only or changes a serialized artifact contract. Release and schema versions are independent.
